'''Bolzi Design & Transmogrification''' was an architectural firm managed by members of the [[Ugor/Legends|Ugor]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. In [[84 BBY/Legends|84 BBY]], the company built the [[luxury port]]s for the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]], incorporating [[morphometric technology]] in its system, which represented a great scientific achievement at the [[Time/Legends|time]].
